test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length, breadth and height of a hall are 10 m, 20 m and 15 m respectively. Find the cost of whitewashing the walls of the inside of the hall and ceiling at the rate of Rs. 10.20/m²
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the hall = 10 m

Breadth of the hall = 20 m

Height of the hall = 15 m

Rate of whitewashing of walls = Rs.10.20/m²

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = L × B

Area of four walls = 2 × H × (L + B)

Where, L = length; B = breadth; H = height

**Calculation:**

The total area of the hall = Area of four walls + area of the ceiling

⇒ 2 × H × (L + B) + (L × B)

⇒ 2 × 15 × (10 + 20) + (10 × 20)

⇒ 2 × 15 × 30 + 200

⇒ 900 + 200 = 1100 m²

Total cost = 1100 × 10.20 = Rs.11220

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.11220.**
